evidence.text: Fruit 田 growing on a tree 木
Pictograph of fruit growing on a tree.
木實也。从木，象果形在木之上。

Pictogram (象形) – fruits on a tree. Related to the original form of 采. Compare 栗 and 某. Unrelated to 喿.
Possibly related to 卵 (OC *ɡ·roːlʔ, *ɡ·roːnʔ, “egg”) (Sagart and Ma, 2020).

editorial_rules: Write about the character's graphic history; distinguish it from the history of a spoken word.
